notes.title: CursedSword is officially out on Steam!
notes.content:
[h1][b]CusedSword has officially released![/b][/h1]

After years of development, we're proud to share this passion project with you. What began as a simple puzzle idea grew into a full adventure with mind-bending rooms, memorable characters, and epic boss battles. Thank you for supporting us on this journey, your enthusiasm means the world to our tiny team. We can’t wait to see how you break the curse.

[b] Slide. Charge. Strike.[/b]
Each step powers up your attack, but build too much strength, and the curse will consume you. Navigate traps, outwit monsters, and break the curse in this Sokoban-style puzzle adventure!

[b] Turn-Based Boss Battles[/b]
Face the Countess’s elite guardians in epic turn-based boss battles. Outsmart deadly patterns and manage your cursed power to survive each climactic showdown.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2200230/CursedSword/

[b]20% Off Launch Discount[/b]
For a limited time, get CursedSword at 20% off! It’s the perfect time to dive into a unique mix of puzzle, tactics, and danger.

[b]How you can support us[/b]
We’re a small indie team, and your support means the world. If you enjoy the game, leaving a review helps more than you know.
Share it with friends, post your best puzzle solves, or just spread the word. Every wishlist, share, and mention matters.

Thank you for all the support! Now go end the curse!

Jester Rat Games
